nodes.description:
RDE on nanostructured electrodes
Owner: ICPEES@CNRS/Unistra:Elena Savinova, Emiliana Fabbri, Tim Welmers
Task: T1.3
Maturity: unknown
Documentation: doi.org/10.1016/j.electacta.2007.11.057doi.org/10.1016/B978-0-444-63278-4.00007-0
Range of validity or processability: 
Valid for the oxygen reactions (OER/ORR) owing to thier slow kinetics, indepently of acidic/alkaline) and for all reactions when using non-Pt (i.e., slow kinetics systems). Design of the cell/choice of the reference/counter electrode has to be considered when moving from an acidic to alkaline pH range.
